rows.ARS:
Dark red Grandiflora.
Registration name: KORbeteilich
Exhibition name: Crimson Bouquet ™
rows.Origin:
Bred by Wilhelm Kordes III (1953 - 2016) (Germany, 1996).
Introduced in Germany by W. Kordes' Söhne (Retail) in 1999.
Introduced in United States by Bear Creek Gardens, Inc. in 2000 as 'Crimson Bouquet'.
rows.Bloom: Dark red. Mild, sweet fragrance. 25 to 30 petals. Average diameter 4". Large, very double, borne mostly solitary, in small clusters, high-centered bloom form. Continuous (perpetual) bloom throughout the season. Medium, long, pointed, ovoid buds.
rows.Habit:
Glossy, leathery foliage. 5 leaflets.

Height: 5'1" to 5'7" (155 to 170cm). Width: 35" to 43" (90 to 110cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) . Can be grown in the ground or in a container (container requires winter protection).
